description: This file defines the AppDatabase class and associated Data Access Object (DAO) classes for managing database interactions related to users, workouts, and goals in a fitness mobile app. It includes database initialization, schema creation, and CRUD operations.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for database setup, including schema creation and providing access to DAOs.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Data access object for performing operations on the 'users' table.

classes.name: WorkoutDao
classes.description: Data access object for performing operations on the 'workouts' table.

classes.name: GoalDao
classes.description: Data access object for performing operations on the 'goals' table.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating tables if necessary, and instantiates DAOs.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Creates the database schema with tables for users, workouts, and goals.

methods.name: getFirstUser
methods.description: Retrieves the first user record from the database, if any.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the corresponding table.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a user based on email existence.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all records from the corresponding table.

methods.name: countAll
methods.description: Counts all records in the workouts table.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing record in the goals table.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all goals, ordered by completion status and id.

methods.name: countCompleted
methods.description: Counts the number of completed goals.
